title: When Mathematics Meets Painting: Fibonacci Geometry, Cubism and Visual Abstraction
summary: This paper explores the Fibonacci sequence and the Golden Ratio as organizing principles for visual composition and abstraction in painting. The author shows how recursive proportional systems, long associated with natural growth and aesthetic harmony, inform artistic structure and visual balance. The discussion traces Fibonacci-based geometry from Renaissance art to modern and contemporary practices, with particular attention to Cubism, where fragmentation and multiple viewpoints echo principles of recursion and geometric division.
